route_title: Chirped thickness stack to broaden visible reflection band
compilation_rationale: Compact thirty-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack compiled with a fixed alternating sequence. Each layer thickness is independently optimizable within broad bounds to naturally realize the prescribed chirped spectral profile without manual chirp-coupling. Reflectance uniformity in 400–700 nm is enforced via a worst-case lower bound target alongside mean maximization, while transmission in 1530–1565 nm is targeted for minimization. Registry-resolved optical constants applied throughout.
